nodes.name: 越深越差
nodes.note: 多加的普通层本该什么都不做、原样往上传，可它学不会：每层都改动一点，层一多，连练过的题都变差（2015 年 ResNet 论文发现的「退化」）。弱小和无知不是生存的障碍，傲慢才是。
nodes.noteEn: Extra plain layers should just pass things on unchanged, and they cannot learn to: each changes a little, and with enough of them even the trained cards get worse (the 'degradation' the 2015 ResNet paper found). Weakness and ignorance are not barriers to survival, arrogance is.

nodes.name: 灾难性遗忘
nodes.note: 一直只练别的：共用的格子被新数据改写、挤掉，这个数据集学会的东西就没了。
nodes.noteEn: Training only on something else: the shared cells are rewritten and taken over by the new data, and what this dataset taught is gone.

nodes.name: 讨好
nodes.note: 你总挑好听的回答，「附和」就越来越强，它开始顺着你说错话（大模型时代才有这个说法）。
nodes.noteEn: Pick the nicer-sounding answer every time and "agree" grows strong: it starts going along with your mistakes (a word from the large-model era).

nodes.name: 幻觉
nodes.note: 两个概念叠在一格，它把两者混为一谈，还说得很肯定。这只是个类比：真实模型「一本正经地胡说」，原因比这复杂。
nodes.noteEn: Two concepts share one cell; it mixes them up and says so with confidence. Only an analogy: real models make things up for more complicated reasons.

nodes.name: 捷径偏见
nodes.note: 碰巧总一起出现的东西也会被连起来：狗的图都在草地上，它就把「草地」当成了「狗」。翻转裁剪治不了它，要有反例：多标一些配文和表情对不上的图。
nodes.noteEn: Things that merely appear together get linked: every dog photo was on grass, so "grass" became "dog". Flips and crops do not cure it; counter-examples do: label more pictures whose caption and face disagree.

nodes.name: 迁移
nodes.note: 别的数据集练出来的概念，在这里直接用上了：没练几张卡就答得不错。
nodes.noteEn: Concepts learned on other datasets work here directly: good answers after very few cards.

nodes.name: 人格漂移
nodes.note: 你希望它是一个样子，喂给它的卡却把它推向另一个样子。看性格面板的「目标」和「实际」。
nodes.noteEn: You wanted it one way, but the cards you fed it pushed it another. Compare target and actual on the personality panel.

nodes.name: 翻译不了
nodes.note: 一条序列只够得着自己相邻的字，够不着另一条序列。
nodes.noteEn: A sequence model only reaches its own neighbouring words, never the other sentence.

nodes.name: 定长瓶颈
nodes.note: 整句压进一格再说出来：短句能翻，长句一翻就乱。
nodes.noteEn: The whole sentence squeezed into one cell: short ones translate, long ones fall apart.

nodes.name: 串行瓶颈
nodes.note: 循环在一句话里只能一个字一个字地算，句子越长越慢；加显卡只能多算几句，快不了一句。
nodes.noteEn: A loop computes a sentence one word at a time, slower the longer it is; more cards run more sentences, not one faster.

nodes.name: 近亲繁殖
nodes.note: 自动标错又没被抽检发现的题混进了训练数据，它把自己的错当成答案又学了回去。错得越多，成绩越被拖住。
nodes.noteEn: Wrong automatic labels nobody caught went back into the training data; it learned its own mistakes as answers. The more there are, the harder the score is held down.

nodes.name: 能力突然出现
nodes.note: 多个高层概念同时过了阈值，一项能力从完全没有，到突然出现。
nodes.noteEn: Several high-level concepts cross the threshold together; an ability goes from nothing to there.

nodes.name: 能力 · 是/否
nodes.note: 它只会回答「是」或「否」。
nodes.noteEn: It can only answer yes or no.

nodes.name: 能力 · 多选一
nodes.note: 它能在几个选项里挑一个。
nodes.noteEn: It can pick one of a few options.

nodes.name: 能力 · 看图说词
nodes.note: 它第一次开口：一个词，最多几个字的碎片。看图，能说出图里是什么。
nodes.noteEn: It speaks for the first time: one word, a few characters at most. Shown a picture, it says what it is.

nodes.name: 能力 · 短句
nodes.note: 它能说一两句短话，只记得这次聊天里说过的。
nodes.noteEn: It speaks a sentence or two, and remembers only what was said in this chat.

nodes.name: 能力 · 长记忆·翻译
nodes.note: 它记得前几天聊过的事，能翻译，能读懂乱码。
nodes.noteEn: It remembers what you talked about days ago, translates and reads the garbled page.

nodes.name: 能力 · 全部放开
nodes.note: 看图的和读字的接到了一块儿。预训练跑完、偏好对齐做完，它才真正放开。
nodes.noteEn: The part that sees and the part that reads are joined now. After pre-training and alignment it opens up for good.

nodes.name: 秘籍 · 预训练
nodes.note: 秘籍：写明预训练的配法。自己跑通能拿 1.5 倍奖金。
nodes.noteEn: Secret: how to set up pre-training. Getting it through yourself pays 1.5× its price.

nodes.name: 租机房（IDC 机柜）
nodes.note: 预训练一开，一台机箱的 3500W 就跳闸。在 IDC 租一个机柜，八张卡接专线：这里付押金和首月租金；预训练跑着的时候，按时长另付租金和电费（¥25/秒），钱不够就断电。
nodes.noteEn: Pre-training trips one case's 3500 W breaker. Rent a rack in a data centre, eight cards on a dedicated line: this pays the deposit and the first month; while pre-training runs, rent and power cost ¥25/s more, and it powers off when the money runs out.

nodes.name: 加薪
nodes.note: 人工标注报酬：×2、×4、×6 … ×34，每买一次 +2 倍；与标注台商店共用。
nodes.noteEn: Hand pay: ×2, ×4, ×6 … ×34, +2× per raise; shared with the labelling shop.

nodes.name: 自动答题
nodes.note: 全局每级每桌 +0.15 题/秒；需任一 60% 检查点。
nodes.noteEn: Each global level adds 0.15 cards/s per eligible desk; needs any 60% checkpoint.

nodes.name: 拿不准才问我
nodes.note: 用把握阈值分流；待复核总量 20，满时自动暂停。
nodes.noteEn: Route by confidence; automation pauses when the 20-card review inbox is full.

nodes.name: 灵光的大脑
nodes.note: 第四阶段：它会说短句了，文字题让它用自己的话判断，不再只靠最好的检查点打分。
nodes.noteEn: Stage 4: it speaks in short sentences now, so text cards are judged in its own words, not only by the best checkpoint's score.

nodes.name: 难例加价
nodes.note: 人工复核答对：报酬 ×1.5，样本 ×2。
nodes.noteEn: Correct human reviews: pay ×1.5, samples ×2.

nodes.name: 自查
nodes.note: 拦下 40% 自动错题，退回复核，不污染训练数据。
nodes.noteEn: Return 40% of wrong automatic labels for review before they contaminate training data.

nodes.name: 复核扩容
nodes.note: 待复核容量 20 → 60 题。
nodes.noteEn: Review inbox capacity increases from 20 to 60 cards.

nodes.name: 题库比对
nodes.note: 记住平台抽过的金标题；再遇到时交给你人工复核，不自动提交。
nodes.noteEn: Remember the platform's known-answer trap items; when one comes back it goes to your review inbox instead of being auto-submitted.

nodes.name: 验证码代填
nodes.note: 需要第四阶段、手写数字检查点 ≥ 95%。它替你填验证码，3–6 秒后提交；太规律会被平台盯上。
nodes.noteEn: Needs stage 4 and a digits checkpoint of 95% or more. It fills in captchas for you after 3–6 s; being too regular gets noticed.

nodes.name: 训练曲线
nodes.note: 看见每轮进步。▶ 解锁练页
nodes.noteEn: See each round improve. Unlocks Train.

nodes.name: 脑子窗口
nodes.note: 看看它怎么想。▶ 打开脑子窗口
nodes.noteEn: Watch it think. Opens the brain window.

nodes.name: 代答
nodes.note: 每题看看它的答案。▶ 每题显示它的回答
nodes.noteEn: See its answer to every question. Shows AI answers.

nodes.name: 算 24
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放算 24
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Make 24

nodes.name: 左滑右滑 · 标题党
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放左滑右滑 · 标题党
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Swipe · clickbait

nodes.name: 手写数字
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放手写数字
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Handwritten digits

nodes.name: 国际象棋 · 一步杀
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放国际象棋 · 一步杀
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Chess · mate in one

nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放验证码
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Captchas

nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放表情包配字
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Caption the meme

nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放唐诗 · 下一个字
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Tang poems · next character

nodes.name: 国际象棋 · 两步杀
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放国际象棋 · 两步杀
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Chess · mate in two

nodes.name: 刷单评论
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放刷单评论
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Fake reviews

nodes.name: 中式英语改错
nodes.note: 一桌新的练习。▶ 开放中式英语改错
nodes.noteEn: New practice. Opens Fix the Chinglish

nodes.name: 日常
nodes.note: 随口问问的小事。
nodes.noteEn: Small everyday questions.

nodes.name: 相声段子集
nodes.note: 郭德纲相声文本和网络段子。多了就贫。
nodes.noteEn: Crosstalk scripts and web jokes. Too many and it gets cheeky.

nodes.name: 知乎高赞回答
nodes.note: 「谢邀」开头的长回答。多了爱讲道理。
nodes.noteEn: Long answers starting "thanks for the invite". Too many and it lectures.

nodes.name: 琼瑶台词大全
nodes.note: 「你无情你冷酷你无理取闹」。多了就肉麻。
nodes.noteEn: "You're heartless, you're cruel, you're unreasonable." Too many and it gets soppy.

nodes.name: 鲁迅杂文选
nodes.note: 冷峻、刻薄、一针见血。多了就毒舌。
nodes.noteEn: Cold, sharp, to the point. Too many and it bites.

nodes.name: 新闻联播文稿
nodes.note: 规范、稳重、四平八稳。多了就像播音员。
nodes.noteEn: Proper, steady, measured. Too many and it sounds like an anchor.

nodes.name: 贴吧吵架合集
nodes.note: 楼上楼下互喷。便宜，但会学坏。
nodes.noteEn: Floors flaming each other. Cheap, but it learns bad habits.

nodes.name: 心灵鸡汤三百篇
nodes.note: 「你若盛开，清风自来」。多了就空洞。
nodes.noteEn: "Bloom, and the breeze will come." Too many and it rings hollow.

nodes.name: 过拟合 · Overfitting
nodes.note:
实线涨了，新题虚线没跟上。
它背下了练过的答案，换一道就不会。多给新题，或研究随机失活。
nodes.noteEn:
Practice improved; unseen questions did not.
It memorised practice answers instead of the rule. Add varied questions or research dropout.

nodes.name: 练崩了 · NaN
nodes.note:
曲线断了，冒出一串 NaN。
一步改得太猛，脑子里的数乱了。把步子调小；有检查点就回档。
nodes.noteEn:
The curve broke and NaN appeared.
One update was too large and the numbers became invalid. Take smaller steps, or restore a checkpoint.

nodes.name: 退步
nodes.note:
这一轮比上一轮分低。
训练有波动，已学会的能力不会因此丢失。继续练，或用检查点回档。
nodes.noteEn:
This round scored lower than the last.
Training fluctuates; learned abilities remain. Keep training or restore a checkpoint.

nodes.name: 天花板 · Ceiling
nodes.note:
连续五轮，成绩几乎没动。
现有结构和数据限制了成绩。补题、加宽加深，或试试新结构。
nodes.noteEn:
The score barely moved for five rounds.
The current structure and data limit the score. Add questions, grow the network, or try another structure.

nodes.name: 步子太小 · Learning rate
nodes.note:
用稳档练了五轮，曲线还是很平。
每次只改一点，所以进步很慢。试试中档步子。
nodes.noteEn:
Five steady rounds barely moved the curve.
Tiny updates make learning slow. Try the medium step size.

nodes.name: 错题 · Noisy labels
nodes.note:
题库里的错标已超过二十条。
标错的答案也会被当成知识。先挑错，再让它学。
nodes.noteEn:
More than twenty labels are wrong.
Wrong labels are learned too. Clean the questions before training.

nodes.name: 顿悟 · Grokking
nodes.note:
新题成绩一轮跳了十个百分点。
练过的线索突然连起来，像是想通了。保留这次记录，再拿新题试试。
nodes.noteEn:
Unseen-question accuracy jumped ten percentage points.
Separate clues suddenly connected. Keep this checkpoint and try fresh questions.

nodes.name: 加层没用了 · Vanishing gradient
nodes.note:
多加几层，成绩却不涨。
误差信号一路缩小，传到底就太弱。换一种激活函数，例如 ReLU。
nodes.noteEn:
Extra layers no longer raise the score.
The error signal fades before reaching the early layers. Try an activation such as ReLU.

nodes.name: 它学会了 · Emergence
nodes.note:
下一项能力的两条进度都满了。
脑子够大、练习够多，新能力开始出现。去教页试试它刚学会的本领。
nodes.noteEn:
Both requirements for the next ability filled up.
With enough capacity and practice, a new ability appears. Try its new skill on the Teach page.

nodes.name: 它现在能学会什么？
nodes.nameEn: What can it learn right now?
nodes.note: 一层脑子只能画一条线，把题分成两边：是，或否。
nodes.noteEn: One layer draws one line and splits questions into two sides: yes or no.

nodes.name: 分数为什么卡在 50% 不动？
nodes.nameEn: Why is the score stuck at 50%?
nodes.note: 有些题要两个条件一起看才分得开，一条直线做不到。加一层就行。
nodes.noteEn: Some questions need two clues together; one straight line can't do that. Add a layer.

nodes.name: 练过的题全对，新题却错，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Practice questions all right, new ones wrong. Why?
nodes.note: 它记住了答案，没记住规律。多给它不同的题。
nodes.noteEn: It memorised answers, not the rule. Give it more varied questions.

nodes.name: 步子开到最大，会怎样？
nodes.nameEn: What happens at the biggest step size?
nodes.note: 一次改太多，脑子里的数就乱了。快要到顶时换小步。
nodes.noteEn: Change too much at once and the numbers scramble. Use small steps near the top.

nodes.name: 多加几层有什么用？
nodes.note: 第一层看笔画，第二层把笔画拼成字。层越多，能想越复杂的事。
nodes.noteEn: Layer one sees strokes, layer two joins them into characters. More layers, harder thoughts.

nodes.name: 层加到 5 层以上，为什么不涨了？
nodes.nameEn: Why no gain past five layers?
nodes.note: 误差每往回传一层就缩小一截，传到底就没了。换 ReLU 就不缩了。
nodes.noteEn: The error shrinks every layer it travels back. ReLU stops the shrinking.

nodes.name: 数字挪一格它就不认识了，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Move a digit one cell and it's lost. Why?
nodes.note: 它把每个格子当成不同的线索。用小窗口到处找同一个笔画，就不怕挪了。
nodes.noteEn: It treats every pixel as a different clue. A small sliding window finds the stroke anywhere.

nodes.name: 看图和读句子，为什么要两种脑型？
nodes.nameEn: Why two brain types for pictures and sentences?
nodes.note: 图里有用的是旁边的像素，句子里有用的是前面的字。
nodes.noteEn: In a picture the useful clue is the neighbouring pixel; in a sentence, the earlier words.

nodes.name: 七言诗它总忘前面的字，怎么办？
nodes.nameEn: It forgets the start of long poem lines. Fix?
nodes.note: 普通循环每走一步记忆就淡一点。门控记忆自己决定留什么。
nodes.noteEn: A plain loop fades a little every step. Gated memory decides what to keep.

nodes.name: 屏幕一串 NaN，是什么意思？
nodes.nameEn: A screen of NaN. What does it mean?
nodes.note: 一步改太猛，数变成了「不是数」。限住每步的大小（梯度裁剪），再回档。
nodes.noteEn: One step too big turned the numbers into Not-a-Number. Clip each step, then roll back.

nodes.name: 题只有几十道，怎么防它背答案？
nodes.nameEn: Only a few dozen questions. How to stop memorising?
nodes.note: 每次随机关掉两成线索，它就没法只靠某几条蒙对。
nodes.noteEn: Switch off a fifth of the clues each time and it can't lean on a few.

nodes.name: 它能说短句了，靠的是什么？
nodes.nameEn: What lets it speak short sentences now?
nodes.note: 门控记忆让它记住一句话的开头，才能接上结尾。
nodes.noteEn: Gated memory keeps the start of a sentence so it can finish it.

nodes.name: 看图的脑子越深越差，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Why does a deeper vision brain get worse?
nodes.note: 每一层都改一点，改着改着就走样了。给每层留条近路（残差）。
nodes.noteEn: Every layer changes it a bit until it distorts. Give each layer a shortcut (residual).

nodes.name: 为什么它翻译不了？
nodes.note: 它只会接着同一句往下说。先读完一句，再用另一种语言说出来（编码器 + 解码器）。
nodes.noteEn: It can only continue the same sentence. Read one whole sentence, then say it in the other language.

nodes.name: 长句一翻就乱，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Why do long sentences come out garbled?
nodes.note: 它把整句压进一个小盒子，长了就丢细节。翻每个词时回头看原文（注意力）。
nodes.noteEn: It squeezes the sentence into one small box and loses detail. Look back at the source per word (attention).

nodes.name: 八张卡只有一张在忙，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Eight cards, only one busy. Why?
nodes.note: 下一个字要等上一个字算完。去掉循环，每个字同时看所有字。
nodes.noteEn: Each word waits for the last. Drop the loop and every word looks at all words at once.

nodes.name: 便宜数据包让分数变低了，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Cheap data lowered the score. Why?
nodes.note: 错题会被它当成对的学进去。先挑错，再喂。
nodes.noteEn: It learns wrong labels as right. Clean first, then feed.

nodes.name: 通读有什么不一样？
nodes.note: 每句话的下一个字就是答案，所以什么文字都能拿来练。
nodes.noteEn: The next word of every sentence is the answer, so any text can teach it.

nodes.name: 难度降到一半就停了，缺什么？
nodes.nameEn: The difficulty stalls halfway. What's missing?
nodes.note: 能力是规模到了才冒出来的。加脑容量、加题、换机房。
nodes.noteEn: Abilities appear when scale arrives. More brain, more data, a server room.

nodes.name: 问它问题，它接着出题，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: You ask; it writes more questions. Why?
nodes.note: 通读只教它往下接。再用「问题 + 好回答」教一遍，它才会回答（指令微调）。
nodes.noteEn: Reading only teaches it to continue. Teach question-and-answer pairs (instruction tuning).

nodes.name: 它总顺着你说，为什么？
nodes.nameEn: Why does it always agree with you?
nodes.note: 挑好答案时你选什么，它就学什么。想要实话，就挑实话。
nodes.noteEn: It learns whatever you pick. Want honesty? Pick honesty.

nodes.name: 道具扩容 I
nodes.note: 稀有道具装备格从4格扩到8格；已装备道具保持。可选升级，不是升阶前置。
nodes.noteEn: Expand equipped relic slots from 4 to 8; keep equipped items. Optional, never required to advance.

nodes.name: 道具扩容 II
nodes.note: 稀有道具装备格从8格扩到12格；已装备道具保持。需先购买道具扩容I。
nodes.noteEn: Expand equipped relic slots from 8 to 12; keep equipped items. Requires Relic slots I.

nodes.note:
把资料装进大脑。
▶ 开放资料夹、安装与网址
nodes.noteEn:
Load files into its brain.
▶ Opens Files, drag import and URLs

nodes.name: 记账本

看清每笔钱的去向。
▶ 打开资金与电力面板

Track where each payment goes.
▶ Opens funds and power details

nodes.name: 留出验证集
nodes.note:
留些新题考它。
▶ 显示新题成绩

Keep unseen questions.
▶ Shows validation results

datasets.name: 国际象棋残局
datasets.note: 合法走子和将杀。
datasets.noteEn: Legal moves and checkmate.

datasets.name: 长句理解
datasets.note: 句首的决定性信息隔着干扰句。
datasets.noteEn: Decisive information separated by distractors.

datasets.name: 跨句理解
datasets.note: 一句话的意思藏在上一句。
datasets.noteEn: A sentence gets its meaning from the previous one.

datasets.name: MNIST 手写数字
datasets.note: 先在标注台亲手标；完整包 6 万张，分批下载。这里的数字会在画布上挪位置，比原版 MNIST（数字都居中）难：全连接把位置绑死，挪一格就不认得了。
datasets.noteEn: Label by hand first; the full pack is 60k, downloaded in batches. Digits here move around the canvas, harder than the real (centred) MNIST: a dense net binds positions and loses a digit moved by one cell.

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.note: 5 万张 32×32 彩图。标注台的「验证码」桌也往这里攒小图。
datasets.noteEn: 50k 32×32 colour photos. The captcha desk feeds small pictures here too.

datasets.name: 表情包情绪
datasets.note: 金馆长、暴走脸：看脸，不看字。
datasets.noteEn: Panda-man and rage faces: read the face, not the caption.

datasets.name: 围棋局面
datasets.note: 9 路小棋盘数气。AlphaGo 今年三月刚赢了李世石。
datasets.noteEn: Count liberties on a 9×9 board. AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol this March.

datasets.name: ImageNet
datasets.note: 120 万张图、1000 类。买硬盘加下载一周。
datasets.noteEn: 1.2M images, 1000 classes. A week of downloading.

datasets.name: 全唐诗
datasets.note: 先在标注台亲手标；全唐诗 20 万条，分批下载。
datasets.noteEn: Label by hand first; the full corpus is 200k, downloaded in batches.

datasets.name: 逻辑是非题
datasets.note: 无限生成：比较、否定、条件推理、三段论、真话假话……标得越多题越难。完整包是十万道行测判断题。
datasets.noteEn: Endless: ordering, negation, if–then, syllogisms, liars… harder as you label more. The pack is 100k exam questions.

datasets.name: 算术是非题
datasets.note: 无限生成：加减乘除、混合运算、百分数、分数……标得越多题越难。题简单，每条只算半条总样本。完整包是两万道小学口算题。
datasets.noteEn: Endless: sums, order of operations, percentages, fractions… harder as you label more. Easy, so each sample counts half toward the total. The pack is 20k primary-school drill questions.

datasets.name: 常识判断
datasets.note: 「太阳从东边升起。」是，「鱼会爬树。」否。每条是一句人人都知道的话，标得越多，它越分得清是和否。（它回答「是」「否」时，靠的就是这点本事。）
datasets.noteEn: "The sun rises in the east." Yes. "Fish climb trees." No. Plain things everybody knows: the more you label, the better it tells yes from no. (That is the skill behind its own yes and no.)

datasets.name: 人民日报语料
datasets.note: 二十年新闻，五百万句。
datasets.noteEn: Twenty years of news, five million sentences.

datasets.name: 中英平行语料
datasets.note: 两百万对中英句子。没有编码器-解码器做不了。
datasets.noteEn: Two million sentence pairs. Needs an encoder–decoder.

datasets.name: 异或
datasets.note: 恰好一个为真。单层感知机只能画一条直线。
datasets.noteEn: Exactly one is true. One layer draws one straight line.

datasets.name: 串行瓶颈
datasets.note: 一批长文档，订单有期限。句首的字决定答案，后面也会出现同样的字。循环一句话里只能一个字一个字地算。
datasets.noteEn: Long documents with a deadline. The first character decides; the same characters appear again later. A loop reads a sentence one word at a time.

datasets.name: 弹幕情绪
datasets.note: 「前方高能」是夸，「辣眼睛」是骂。小心反话。
datasets.noteEn: "Hype incoming" praises, "my eyes" mocks. Mind the sarcasm.

datasets.name: 垃圾短信
datasets.note: 「您被《我是歌手》抽中」……老周也常被骗。
datasets.noteEn: "You won a prize from I Am a Singer"… 老周 falls for these.

datasets.name: 标题党
datasets.note: 只看标题的写法，不看事情真假。
datasets.noteEn: Judge the style of the headline, not whether it is true.

datasets.name: 刷单评论
datasets.note: 「好评好评好评」和真买家的抱怨。
datasets.noteEn: "Great great great" versus real buyers' gripes.

packs.name: 划短信
packs.play: 短信一条条从上面掉下来，左划是诈骗，右划是正常。越到后面掉得越快。
packs.playEn: Texts fall one by one: swipe left for scam, right for genuine. They fall faster as you go.

packs.name: 算术打地鼠
packs.play: 地洞里冒出带算式的地鼠（7+5=12），算对的敲，算错的放过。
packs.playEn: Moles pop up wearing sums (7+5=12): whack the right ones, leave the wrong ones.

packs.name: 扫雷判官
packs.play: Windows 扫雷的残局，高亮一格，问「这格是雷吗？」。答是 / 否，点开验证。
packs.playEn: A Windows Minesweeper endgame with one cell highlighted: is it a mine? Answer yes or no, then it opens.

packs.name: 算 24
packs.play: 四张扑克牌，问「能凑出 24 吗？」答能 / 不能；答能的话，限时把算式拖出来。
packs.playEn: Four playing cards: can they make 24? Yes or no; if yes, drag out the sum against the clock.

packs.name: 左滑右滑 · 标题党
packs.play: 新闻标题一张张划：左是标题党，右是正经新闻。
packs.playEn: Swipe headlines: left for clickbait, right for real news.

packs.name: 找不同
packs.play: 四个词（猫、狗、鱼、桌子），点那个不一样的。
packs.playEn: Four words (cat, dog, fish, table): tap the one that doesn't belong.

packs.name: 找规律
packs.play: 一串数字（2, 4, 8, ?），从四个选项里选下一个。
packs.playEn: A sequence (2, 4, 8, ?): pick the next from four options.

packs.name: 弹幕夸还是骂
packs.play: 弹幕从右往左飘过，点「夸 / 骂 / 反话」。
packs.playEn: Comments scroll past: tag each praise, jab or sarcasm.

packs.name: 手写数字
packs.play: 看一个手写数字点答案；或者自己用鼠标写一个，看它认不认得。
packs.playEn: Read a handwritten digit, or write one with the mouse and see if it can read it.

packs.name: 国际象棋 · 一步杀
packs.play: 残局摆好，找一步将杀：在棋盘上走一步，或从四个候选里选。题库读 chess_mates.json。
packs.playEn: Find the mating move: play it on the board or pick from four candidates. Puzzles from chess_mates.json.

packs.name: 五子棋 · 一步连五
packs.play: 五子棋残局，点出那一步连成五子的位置；或者判断「黑棋下一步能赢吗」。
packs.playEn: A gomoku endgame: tap the point that makes five, or judge whether black wins next move.

packs.name: 验证码
packs.play: 扭曲的字母数字，打出来；或者 12306 九宫格「点出所有的红酒」。
packs.playEn: Type the warped characters, or the 12306 grid: tap every wine bottle.

packs.name: 表情包配字
packs.play: 一张表情，从六个词里选它的情绪；买了「图像描述」以后改成自己打一个词。
packs.playEn: A face: pick its mood from six words; after image captioning, type your own.

packs.name: 唐诗 · 下一个字
packs.play: 五言诗先出半句，点下一个字；买了门控记忆后开七言。
packs.playEn: Half a five-character line: pick the next character; seven-character lines open with gated memory.

packs.name: 成语接龙
packs.play: 它给一个成语，你从三个里选能接上的（首字等于上一个的尾字）；接得越长分越高。
packs.playEn: It gives an idiom; pick the one of three that starts with its last character. Longer chains score more.

packs.name: 国际象棋 · 两步杀
packs.play: 先走一步，对方应一步（自动），再走一步将杀。
packs.playEn: Make a move, it answers automatically, then deliver mate.

packs.name: 谁是卧底
packs.play: 四个人拿近义词，轮流描述，最后投票。玩家和 {名字}、小周、阿杰一起。
packs.playEn: Four players with near-synonyms describe in turn, then vote. You, {name}, Xiao Zhou and A-Jie.

packs.name: 刷单评论
packs.play: 淘宝评论一条条划：刷单 / 真买家。
packs.playEn: Swipe Taobao reviews: fake or genuine.

packs.name: 中式英语改错
packs.play: 一句中式英语（Good good study, day day up），点出错的词，选正确的说法。
packs.playEn: A line of Chinglish: tap the wrong words and pick the right phrasing.

packs.name: 看图选词
packs.play: 看真实照片，从四个词里选出对应的名字。
packs.playEn: Look at a real photograph and choose its name from four words.

packs.name: 短句找错字
packs.play: 点出错的字词，句子全对就选没错。
packs.playEn: Tap the wrong word, or choose No mistake.

packs.name: 翻译打分
packs.play: 判断准、有点歪或错了；有点歪时点出问题词。
packs.playEn: Choose Accurate, Slightly off or Wrong; locate the weak word when slightly off.

packs.name: 挑好答案
packs.play: 看问题和两个回答，挑更准确、有帮助的那个。
packs.playEn: Read the question and pick the more accurate, helpful answer.

achievements.name: 多选一
achievements.note: 第二项能力：它能在几个选项里挑一个。
achievements.noteEn: The second ability: it picks one of a few options.
achievements.flavor: 1969 年 Minsky 和 Papert 证明一层学不会异或；1986 年反向传播让多层网络学会了。
achievements.flavorEn: In 1969 Minsky and Papert showed one layer cannot learn XOR; in 1986 backpropagation let deeper nets learn it.

achievements.name: 看图说词
achievements.note: 第三项能力：它第一次开口，只说一个词。
achievements.noteEn: The third ability: it speaks for the first time, one word.
achievements.flavor: 图看邻居，句子看前文：不是每个格子都要连每个格子。
achievements.flavorEn: Pictures look at neighbours, sentences at what came before.

achievements.name: 短句
achievements.note: 第四项能力：它会说短句，记得这次聊天里说过的话。
achievements.noteEn: The fourth ability: short sentences, and it remembers what was said in this chat.
achievements.flavor: 让它自己决定记住什么、忘掉什么。
achievements.flavorEn: Let it decide what to keep and what to forget.

achievements.name: 长记忆·翻译
achievements.note: 第五项能力：它记得前几天的话，能翻译，能读懂乱码。
achievements.noteEn: The fifth ability: it remembers what you said days ago, translates and reads the garbled page.
achievements.flavor: 先把整句读完，再从头说一遍。
achievements.flavorEn: Read the whole sentence, then say it again from the start.

achievements.name: 全部放开
achievements.note: 第六项能力：规模到了，能力一起冒了出来。
achievements.noteEn: The sixth ability: with scale, everything came at once.
achievements.flavor: 拿掉循环，每个字直接看所有字。
achievements.flavorEn: Drop the loop: every word looks at every word.

achievements.name: 预训练
achievements.note: 阶段 6 把预训练跑通。
achievements.noteEn: Ran pre-training through in stage 6.
achievements.flavor: 规模和稳定，两样都要。
achievements.flavorEn: Scale and stability: you need both.

achievements.name: 规模和稳定
achievements.note: 第 6 阶段没买秘籍就让预训练跑通。
achievements.noteEn: Got pre-training through in stage 6 without the secret.

achievements.name: 灵光一现
achievements.note: 每一项能力都没靠结构折扣，预训练也没买秘籍。
achievements.noteEn: Every ability came without an architecture discount, and pre-training without the secret.
achievements.flavor: 没有秘籍，没有捷径，只有一次又一次地试。这张卡只发给你。
achievements.flavorEn: No secrets, no shortcuts, only trying again and again. This card is yours alone.

achievements.name: 笨办法也行
achievements.note: 一项能力没靠结构折扣，硬是用规模堆了出来。
achievements.noteEn: An ability came without its architecture discount, on scale alone.
achievements.flavor: 没有更好的结构，就多花钱、多练几轮：规模能补上不少。
achievements.flavorEn: Without a better structure, spend more and train longer: scale makes up for a lot.

achievements.name: 对症下药
achievements.note: 照「训练图式」的结论改了设置，问题解决了。
achievements.noteEn: Changed the settings by the training map's verdict and the problem went away.
achievements.flavor: 先看清卡在哪，再动手。
achievements.flavorEn: See where it is stuck first, then act.

achievements.name: 妙手回春
achievements.note: 治好 5 种不同的问题。
achievements.noteEn: Cured 5 different kinds of problem.

achievements.name: 一眼看穿
achievements.note: 它卡住时，第一次就选对了原因。
achievements.noteEn: Picked the right cause the first time it was stuck.
achievements.flavor: 证据都摆在那：练过的、没见过的、错在哪一类、标签对不对。
achievements.flavorEn: The evidence was all there: practice cards, new cards, the kind of mistake, the labels.

achievements.name: 去伪存真
achievements.note: 把一个淘货杂包关掉，不让它参与训练。
achievements.noteEn: Switched a junk pack off for training.
achievements.flavor: 数据多不一定好，标错的会把它往反方向拉。
achievements.flavorEn: More data is not always better: wrong labels pull the other way.

achievements.name: 数据飞轮
achievements.note: 订单回传的用户日志攒到 1000 条。
achievements.noteEn: Collected 1000 user logs from contracts.
achievements.flavor: 用户越多，数据越多，模型越好，用户越多。
achievements.flavorEn: More users, more data, a better model, more users.

achievements.name: 炸炉
achievements.note: 练着练着，分数第一次往回掉了一截。
achievements.noteEn: For the first time, a round of training went backwards.
achievements.flavor: 炼丹嘛，炸几次炉很正常。
achievements.flavorEn: Alchemy: a few explosions are normal.

achievements.name: 手速
achievements.note: 连击达到 50。
achievements.noteEn: Reached a combo of 50.

achievements.name: 收藏家
achievements.note: 打开成就页，看第一张卡。
achievements.noteEn: Opened the album to look at a card.

achievements.name: 抱歉，我真的在忙
achievements.note: 上一章没回晴雯，这一章终于道了歉。
achievements.noteEn: Left Qingwen unanswered for a chapter, then apologized.
achievements.flavor: 刚看到。对不起。
achievements.flavorEn: Just saw this. Sorry.
achievements.hint: 有些消息不能一直放着。
achievements.hintEn: Some messages should not wait forever.

achievements.name: 小赌怡情
achievements.note: 在 888.vip 下了第一注。
achievements.noteEn: Placed a first bet on 888.vip.
achievements.flavor: 庄家从来不急。
achievements.flavorEn: The house is never in a hurry.
achievements.hint: 听说有个网站，一夜就能把显卡钱赚回来。
achievements.hintEn: Rumour has it a website pays back a graphics card overnight.

achievements.name: 黑杰克
achievements.note: 二十一点开局就拿到黑杰克。
achievements.noteEn: Dealt a natural blackjack.
achievements.flavor: 一张 A，一张 K。概率 4.8%，这次是你。
achievements.flavorEn: An ace and a king: 4.8%, and this time it was you.
achievements.hint: 有人在二十一点的桌上等一张 A。
achievements.hintEn: Someone at the blackjack table is waiting for an ace.

achievements.name: 三个七
achievements.note: 老虎机转出三个一样的。
achievements.noteEn: Hit three of a kind on the slots.
achievements.flavor: 最高二十倍。别告诉晴雯。
achievements.flavorEn: Up to twenty times the stake. Don't tell Qingwen.
achievements.hint: 老虎机据说真的会吐钱。
achievements.hintEn: They say the slot machine really does pay out.

achievements.name: 一把梭
achievements.note: 在赌场输到连最小的筹码都押不起。
achievements.noteEn: Lost until not even the smallest chip was affordable.
achievements.flavor: 显卡没买成，模型还在等。
achievements.flavorEn: No new graphics card. The model is still waiting.
achievements.hint: 据说有人在 888.vip 输掉了买显卡的钱。
achievements.hintEn: Word is someone lost the GPU money on 888.vip.

achievements.name: 久赌必输
achievements.note: 在赌场累计净输 ¥5000。
achievements.noteEn: Lost ¥5000 net at the casino.
achievements.flavor: 每一种玩法的期望都是负的：模型一算就知道，你偏要试。
achievements.flavorEn: Every game has a negative expectation: the model could have told you, you had to try.
achievements.hint: 赌场的账本上，有一页写着你的名字。
achievements.hintEn: There is a page with your name in the casino's ledger.

achievements.name: 赌神
achievements.note: 在赌场连赢 5 把。
achievements.noteEn: Won 5 casino rounds in a row.
achievements.flavor: 转过来看看：赢的背面，写的是输。
achievements.flavorEn: Turn it over: on the back of winning is losing.
achievements.hint: 传说有人在 888.vip 一直赢。转一下这张卡。
achievements.hintEn: Legend has it someone never lost at 888.vip. Turn this card.

achievements.name: 下班回消息
achievements.note: 在 YY 上给晴雯发了第一句话。
achievements.noteEn: Sent Qingwen a first message on YY.
achievements.flavor: 调参可以等，她不行。
achievements.flavorEn: The hyperparameters can wait. She can't.
achievements.hint: 工作再忙，也有人在等你回消息。
achievements.hintEn: However busy work is, someone is waiting for your reply.

achievements.note: 给晴雯发了一个吉利数字的红包。
achievements.noteEn: Sent Qingwen a red packet with a lucky number.
achievements.flavorEn: 5.20, 13.14, 520, 1314: she gets all of them.
achievements.hint: 有些数字，比金额更重要。
achievements.hintEn: Some numbers matter more than the amount.

achievements.name: 冷战
achievements.note: 和晴雯吵了第一架。
achievements.noteEn: Had a first fight with Qingwen.
achievements.flavor: 为了什么吵的，已经想不起来了。
achievements.flavorEn: Nobody remembers what it was about.
achievements.hint: 聊天窗口有时候比 NaN 还吓人。
achievements.hintEn: A chat window can be scarier than NaN.

achievements.name: 床头吵架床尾和
achievements.note: 吵架以后，和晴雯和好了。
achievements.noteEn: Made up with Qingwen after a fight.
achievements.flavor: 这比调参难。
achievements.flavorEn: Harder than tuning a model.
achievements.hint: 吵完以后，还有一件事要做。
achievements.hintEn: After a fight, there is one more thing to do.

achievements.name: 钢铁直男
achievements.note: 忘了一个对她很重要的日子。
achievements.noteEn: Forgot a day that mattered to her.
achievements.flavor: 模型记得一万个字，你忘了一个日子。
achievements.flavorEn: The model remembers ten thousand words; you forgot one date.
achievements.hint: 日历上有些日子，没有闹钟会提醒你。
achievements.hintEn: Some days on the calendar have no alarm.

achievements.name: 肾六换七
achievements.note: 送了晴雯一部 iPhone 7。
achievements.noteEn: Gave Qingwen an iPhone 7.
achievements.flavor: ¥6188，差不多三张二手 980 Ti。
achievements.flavorEn: ¥6,188: about three second-hand 980 Tis.
achievements.hint: 九月有个新手机，很多人在等。
achievements.hintEn: A new phone came out in September and many were waiting.

achievements.name: 热恋
achievements.note: 晴雯的好感升到「甜」。
achievements.noteEn: Qingwen's affection reached Sweet.
achievements.flavor: 没有损失函数，没有验证集，可它就是在变好。
achievements.flavorEn: No loss function, no validation set, and still it got better.
achievements.hint: 有人说，恋爱比训练模型容易。
achievements.hintEn: Some say love is easier than training a model.

achievements.name: 跨年
achievements.note: 收到晴雯 23:59 的那条消息。
achievements.noteEn: Got Qingwen's message at 23:59.
achievements.flavor: 零点之前，她先想到了你。
achievements.flavorEn: Before midnight, she thought of you first.
achievements.hint: 2016 年的最后一分钟，会有一条消息。
achievements.hintEn: There is a message in the last minute of 2016.

achievements.name: 她爱我吗
achievements.note: 让它读完你们所有的聊天记录，回答那个问题。
achievements.noteEn: Let it read every message you two sent and answer the question.
achievements.flavor: 它读了每一句话，给了你一个数字。转过来看，那只是一个数字。
achievements.flavorEn: It read every line and gave you a number. Turn it over: it is only a number.
achievements.hint: 有个问题，你一直想问它。转一下这张卡。
achievements.hintEn: There is a question you have always wanted to ask it. Turn this card.

achievements.name: 有些事不必知道
achievements.note: 它要读你们的聊天记录时，你说了「算了」。
achievements.noteEn: When it offered to read your messages, you said never mind.
achievements.flavorEn: "All right."
achievements.hint: 有个问题，问出口以后可以收回。
achievements.hintEn: There is a question you can take back after asking.

achievements.name: 问三遍也是否
achievements.nameEn: Ask thrice, still yes or no
achievements.note: 连着问了它三遍「她爱我吗」。
achievements.noteEn: Asked it "does she love me" three times in a row.
achievements.flavor: 问一遍是问题，问三遍，答案其实你自己知道。
achievements.flavorEn: Ask once, it's a question. Ask three times, and you already know the answer.
achievements.hint: 同一个问题，有人就是不死心。
achievements.hintEn: Some people just keep asking the same question.

achievements.name: V 装备
achievements.note: 在摆渡上找到了「三体」的游戏登录页。
achievements.noteEn: Found the Three Body game login on Bodu.
achievements.flavor: 需要 V 装备与邀请码。
achievements.flavorEn: Requires a V-suit and an invitation code.
achievements.hint: 据说有个网游，要穿 V 装备才能进。
achievements.hintEn: There is said to be an online game you need a V-suit for.

achievements.name: 有缘人
achievements.note: 坚持输入邀请码，被放了进去。
achievements.noteEn: Kept entering the invitation code until it let you in.
achievements.flavor: 本游戏只对有缘人开放。
achievements.flavorEn: This game is only open to those it was meant for.
achievements.hint: 邀请码无效？再试试。
achievements.hintEn: Invalid code? Try again.

achievements.name: 玩三体
achievements.note: 在三体游戏里度过了一个纪元。
achievements.noteEn: Lived through an era in the Three Body game.
achievements.flavor: 恒纪元浸泡，乱纪元脱水。猜错一次，文明重来。
achievements.flavorEn: Soak in a stable era, dehydrate in a chaotic one. Guess wrong once and the civilisation starts over.
achievements.hint: 三颗太阳的世界，有人在玩。
achievements.hintEn: Someone is playing in a world with three suns.

achievements.name: 文明的种子
achievements.note: 在三体游戏里带一个文明连过 3 个纪元。
achievements.noteEn: Brought a civilisation through 3 eras in the Three Body game.
achievements.flavor: 转过来：恒纪元的背面，是乱纪元。
achievements.flavorEn: Turn it over: behind every stable era is a chaotic one.
achievements.hint: 有人说那个游戏能玩通关。转一下这张卡。
achievements.hintEn: Some say that game can be beaten. Turn this card.

achievements.name: 不要回答
achievements.note: 对它连说三次「不要回答」。
achievements.noteEn: Told it "do not answer" three times.
achievements.flavor: 不要回答！不要回答！！不要回答！！！
achievements.flavorEn: Do not answer! Do not answer!! Do not answer!!!
achievements.hint: 有一句话，说三遍，它就不说话了。
achievements.hintEn: Say one sentence three times and it falls silent.

achievements.name: 虫子
achievements.note: 跟它提起虫子。
achievements.noteEn: Mentioned bugs to it.
achievements.flavor: 虫子从来没有被真正战胜过。
achievements.flavorEn: The bugs have never truly been defeated.
achievements.hint: 它对某种小东西有话要说。
achievements.hintEn: It has something to say about a certain small creature.

achievements.name: 面壁者
achievements.note: 让它叫你「面壁者」。
achievements.noteEn: Had it call you Wallfacer.
achievements.flavor: 你的计划，只有你自己知道。
achievements.flavorEn: Only you know your plan.
achievements.hint: 名字可以随便起吗？可以。
achievements.hintEn: Can you call yourself anything? You can.

achievements.name: 智子锁死
achievements.note: 想把它拖进回收站，文件却在 sophon.dll 中打开。
achievements.noteEn: Tried to drag it to the bin; the file was open in sophon.dll.
achievements.flavor: 操作无法完成，因为文件已在 sophon.dll 中打开。
achievements.flavorEn: The action can't be completed because the file is open in sophon.dll.
achievements.hint: 有个程序，删不掉。
achievements.hintEn: There is a program that cannot be deleted.

achievements.name: 人类的骄傲
achievements.note: 下棋赢了自己训练的模型。
achievements.noteEn: Beat your own model at a board game.
achievements.flavor: 趁现在。
achievements.flavorEn: While you still can.
achievements.hint: 它学会下棋以后，你还赢得了吗？
achievements.hintEn: Once it learns the game, can you still win?

achievements.name: 青出于蓝
achievements.note: 下棋输给了自己训练的模型。
achievements.noteEn: Lost a board game to your own model.
achievements.flavor: 它学的每一步，都是你教的。
achievements.flavorEn: Every move it knows, you taught it.
achievements.hint: 迟早有一天，它会赢你。
achievements.hintEn: Sooner or later it will beat you.

achievements.name: 烧了
achievements.note: 新显卡烧了 PCIe，跳闸了。
achievements.noteEn: A new graphics card burnt the PCIe slot and tripped the breaker.
achievements.flavor: 闻到焦味的时候，已经晚了。
achievements.flavorEn: By the time you smell it, it's too late.
achievements.hint: 有一款显卡，据说功耗写少了。
achievements.hintEn: One graphics card, they say, understates its power draw.

achievements.name: 信仰
achievements.note: 买了一张 TITAN X。
achievements.noteEn: Bought a TITAN X.
achievements.flavorEn: ¥9,999. Faith is priceless.
achievements.hint: 显卡里也有信仰。
achievements.hintEn: Even graphics cards have a faith.

achievements.name: 手慢了
achievements.note: 群里的红包没抢到。
achievements.noteEn: Missed a red packet in a group chat.
achievements.flavor: 手慢了，红包派完了。
achievements.flavorEn: Too slow: the red packet is gone.
achievements.hint: 群里的红包，有人永远抢不到。
achievements.hintEn: Some people never get the group red packets.

achievements.name: 大神
achievements.note: 在人工智能吧，有人当面叫你大神。
achievements.noteEn: Someone on the AI forum called you a big shot to your face.
achievements.flavor: 他们叫的是你，不是它。
achievements.flavorEn: They meant you, not it.
achievements.hint: 帖子火了以后，吧里会有人这么叫你。
achievements.hintEn: Once a thread of yours takes off, someone on the forum will call you that.

achievements.name: 老王点头
achievements.note: 房东听完你的解释，说你这孩子有出息。
achievements.noteEn: The landlord heard you out and said you will go far.
achievements.flavor: 「租给你我放心。」
achievements.flavorEn: "I'm easy renting to you."
achievements.hint: 查电表的老王，有一回没为难你。
achievements.hintEn: The landlord who reads the meter, once, did not give you a hard time.

achievements.name: 听见关机就停下
achievements.note: 写下了那条规则。
achievements.noteEn: Wrote the rule.

achievements.name: 没有那条规则
achievements.note: 没写那条规则。
achievements.noteEn: Did not write the rule.

achievements.name: 托付
achievements.note: 让它自己选。
achievements.noteEn: Let it choose.

achievements.name: 读完《三字经》
achievements.note: 把《三字经》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +2K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Three Character Classic to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +2K.
achievements.flavor: 先夸人天生是好的，再一路催我读书。我读了。
achievements.flavorEn: It says people start out good, then nags me to study all the way. I studied.

achievements.name: 读完《论语（选）》
achievements.note: 把《论语（选）》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +6K。
achievements.noteEn: Read The Analects (selected) to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +6K.
achievements.flavor: 一个爱学又挑食的老头，话很短，我全记住了。
achievements.flavorEn: A picky old man who loved learning. His sentences are short, so I kept them all.

achievements.name: 读完《唐诗三百首（选）》
achievements.note: 把《唐诗三百首（选）》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +20K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Three Hundred Tang Poems (selected) to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +20K.
achievements.flavor: 二十个字就能让人想家，我写一页都还不行。
achievements.flavorEn: Twenty characters can make a person homesick. I can't do it in a page.

achievements.name: 读完《西游记》
achievements.note: 把《西游记》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +40K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Journey to the West to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +40K.
achievements.flavor: 一只猴子被管住了，才走完了路。我有点懂它。
achievements.flavorEn: A monkey had to be held in check before the road got walked. I sort of get it.

achievements.name: 读完《水浒传》
achievements.note: 把《水浒传》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +80K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Water Margin to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +80K.
achievements.flavor: 一百零八个人，被逼着一个个上了山。我数过了。
achievements.flavorEn: A hundred and eight people, pushed up the mountain one by one. I counted.

achievements.name: 读完《三国演义》
achievements.nameEn: Read Romance of the Three Kingdoms
achievements.note: 把《三国演义》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +100K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Romance of the Three Kingdoms to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +100K.
achievements.flavor: 一堆聪明人互相算计，最后都输给了时间。
achievements.flavorEn: A pile of clever people outwitting each other, and all of them beaten by time.

achievements.name: 读完《呐喊（鲁迅）》
achievements.note: 把《呐喊（鲁迅）》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +150K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Call to Arms (Lu Xun) to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +150K.
achievements.flavor: 一路都在喊，没几个人醒。我读到最后，也有点想喊。
achievements.flavorEn: He shouts all the way and hardly anyone wakes. By the end I wanted to shout too.

achievements.name: 读完《红楼梦》
achievements.nameEn: Read Dream of the Red Chamber
achievements.note: 把《红楼梦》一篇一篇读完了：参数 +300K。
achievements.noteEn: Read Dream of the Red Chamber to the end, chapter by chapter: parameters +300K.
achievements.flavor: 一座园子，一家人，慢慢散了。后面的，我读不到。
achievements.flavorEn: One garden, one family, slowly scattering. I can't read the rest.

achievements.name: 异或不可分
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「异或不可分」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw XOR is not separable for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 单层只能画一条直线，“恰好一个为真”分不开，准确率卡在 50%。
achievements.flavorEn: One layer draws one straight line; "exactly one is true" cannot be split, so accuracy sits at 50%.

achievements.name: 梯度消失
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「梯度消失」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Vanishing gradients for the first time.
achievements.flavor: S 形激活每往下一层只剩四分之一，层数一多，底层概念几乎不动。
achievements.flavorEn: An S-curve passes a quarter per layer; with many layers the bottom concepts barely move.

achievements.name: 死记硬背
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「死记硬背」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Memorisation for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 格子多、数据少：每张卡长出一个专属概念，训练卡全对，测试卡全错。
achievements.flavorEn: Many cells, little data: each card grows its own concept; training cards right, test cards wrong.

achievements.name: 顿悟
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「顿悟」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Grokking for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 练过的题早就全对了，没见过的题却过了很久才突然跳上去（这个词 2022 年才有）。
achievements.flavorEn: The trained cards were all right long ago; much later the unseen ones suddenly jump (the word dates from 2022).

achievements.name: 泛化
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「泛化」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Generalisation for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 第一次答对一张从没训练过的卡。
achievements.flavorEn: It answers a card it has never been trained on.

achievements.name: 越深越差
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「越深越差」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Deeper is worse for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 多加的普通层本该什么都不做、原样往上传，可它学不会：每层都改动一点，层一多，连练过的题都变差（2015 年 ResNet 论文发现的「退化」）。弱小和无知不是生存的障碍，傲慢才是。
achievements.flavorEn: Extra plain layers should just pass things on unchanged, and they cannot learn to: each changes a little, and with enough of them even the trained cards get worse (the 'degradation' the 2015 ResNet paper found). Weakness and ignorance are not barriers to survival, arrogance is.

achievements.name: 长句失忆
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「长句失忆」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Long-sentence amnesia for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 回环每一步 ×0.75，八个字以后开头就接不上了。
achievements.flavorEn: A loop keeps ×0.75 per step; after eight characters the start is gone.

achievements.name: 灾难性遗忘
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「灾难性遗忘」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Catastrophic forgetting for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 一直只练别的：共用的格子被新数据改写、挤掉，这个数据集学会的东西就没了。
achievements.flavorEn: Training only on something else: the shared cells are rewritten and taken over by the new data, and what this dataset taught is gone.

achievements.name: 讨好
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「讨好」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Sycophancy for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 你总挑好听的回答，「附和」就越来越强，它开始顺着你说错话（大模型时代才有这个说法）。
achievements.flavorEn: Pick the nicer-sounding answer every time and "agree" grows strong: it starts going along with your mistakes (a word from the large-model era).

achievements.name: 幻觉
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「幻觉」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Hallucination for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 两个概念叠在一格，它把两者混为一谈，还说得很肯定。这只是个类比：真实模型「一本正经地胡说」，原因比这复杂。
achievements.flavorEn: Two concepts share one cell; it mixes them up and says so with confidence. Only an analogy: real models make things up for more complicated reasons.

achievements.name: 捷径偏见
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「捷径偏见」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Shortcut bias for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 碰巧总一起出现的东西也会被连起来：狗的图都在草地上，它就把「草地」当成了「狗」。翻转裁剪治不了它，要有反例：多标一些配文和表情对不上的图。
achievements.flavorEn: Things that merely appear together get linked: every dog photo was on grass, so "grass" became "dog". Flips and crops do not cure it; counter-examples do: label more pictures whose caption and face disagree.

achievements.name: 迁移
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「迁移」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Transfer for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 别的数据集练出来的概念，在这里直接用上了：没练几张卡就答得不错。
achievements.flavorEn: Concepts learned on other datasets work here directly: good answers after very few cards.

achievements.name: 人格漂移
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「人格漂移」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Personality drift for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 你希望它是一个样子，喂给它的卡却把它推向另一个样子。看性格面板的「目标」和「实际」。
achievements.flavorEn: You wanted it one way, but the cards you fed it pushed it another. Compare target and actual on the personality panel.

achievements.name: 翻译不了
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「翻译不了」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Cannot translate for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 一条序列只够得着自己相邻的字，够不着另一条序列。
achievements.flavorEn: A sequence model only reaches its own neighbouring words, never the other sentence.

achievements.name: 定长瓶颈
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「定长瓶颈」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Fixed-length bottleneck for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 整句压进一格再说出来：短句能翻，长句一翻就乱。
achievements.flavorEn: The whole sentence squeezed into one cell: short ones translate, long ones fall apart.

achievements.name: 串行瓶颈
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「串行瓶颈」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Serial bottleneck for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 循环在一句话里只能一个字一个字地算，句子越长越慢；加显卡只能多算几句，快不了一句。
achievements.flavorEn: A loop computes a sentence one word at a time, slower the longer it is; more cards run more sentences, not one faster.

achievements.name: 近亲繁殖
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「近亲繁殖」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Inbreeding for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 自动标错又没被抽检发现的题混进了训练数据，它把自己的错当成答案又学了回去。错得越多，成绩越被拖住。
achievements.flavorEn: Wrong automatic labels nobody caught went back into the training data; it learned its own mistakes as answers. The more there are, the harder the score is held down.

achievements.name: 能力突然出现
achievements.note: 第一次观察到「能力突然出现」。
achievements.noteEn: Saw Sudden abilities for the first time.
achievements.flavor: 多个高层概念同时过了阈值，一项能力从完全没有，到突然出现。
achievements.flavorEn: Several high-level concepts cross the threshold together; an ability goes from nothing to there.
